verseText: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
meaning: Because Jesus can return at any moment, we must always be ready. And the way to be ready is to trust in him to save us.

recall.question: Why must Jesus' followers be ready?
choices: The Son of Man comes at an unexpected hour

meaning.question: How can we be ready for Jesus?

application.prompt: Live today ready for Jesus by trusting Him and doing what He says is right.
